intro: The Mathematical Society provides resources for students and staff to stay up to date on the department and events. Find related files and resources below.

groups.title: Membership & Registration
groups.description:
To register as a member of the Mathematical Society:

1. Register on our [V-Link page](https://utrgv.campuslabs.com/engage/organization/msoc).
2. Fill out the Membership Contract linked below.

If you wish to be an **Active Member**, you may also send the $20 membership fee to the Cash App on the CashApp Flyer. Please include your full name and purpose in the Cash App note.

The Membership Flyer explains the requirements and benefits of each membership.
